table.retrieve:
select date,
		saleinvcode,
		customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=:ar_custcode),
		amount=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(saleinvcode),
       	aging=DATEDIFF ( dd , date , :ar_enddate ),
        	duedate
from saleledger  SL
where  SL.date>=:ar_startdate AND
		  SL.date<=:ar_enddate AND
		  SL.custcode=:ar_custcode
Order by saleinvcode
